第三十二章 同门尽数撤离独留二人守山（第1页）
战后，两名金丹长老迈步走入战场，运转精纯金丹灵力，逐一压制众人体内残留的阴邪煞气，暂时稳住所有人的伤势。
赵磊小臂骨裂，内伤深重，无法行动；许巧后背伤势凶险，失血过多昏迷不醒；苏晚晴肩头带伤，连日激战加上同门战死，心神损耗极大，三人都无法继续留在荒僻后山值守，必须即刻返回宗门驻地疗伤休养。
没过多久，金丹长老门下随行弟子尽数赶到，抬着担架等候撤离。
按照长老最终安排，原先整支后山值守小队全员撤离，不留一人。
一来陈默此战提前布下埋伏，对战局助力极大，心性沉稳适合留守并且他在这场战斗中并未受什么伤此处毕竟为我门派的重地只有雇佣来的驻守大有危机；二来阴魂剑克制尸邪，适配后山山林环境；三来怀中灵狐战力强横，可暗中应对后续未知危险，留他在此最为稳妥。
于是一位长老指了指他身旁的一位弟子，说道“苟道友、苏道友这是我的亲传弟子孟峰就由他带队吧。”另一位长老，瞧了瞧那个被指的年轻人看他长得端正也点了点头说“周道友我看可以，这位小兄弟身姿不凡，还是你的亲传弟子想必神通不少，道法造诣不低吧？”
他来驻守甚是妥当。”之后他便看向了苏晚晴，问道“苏道友，意欲何为啊。哈，哈哈哈。”
苏晚晴不情愿道“可以，我没意见。
接替后山防务的留守队伍很快集结完毕，队伍领头弟子孟峰缓步走出。然后他看了看陈默，对他点了点头。于是就看了看他周围的修士们，满意的又点了一下头并与大家寒暄了一番。
孟峰生得一副俊秀皮囊，眉眼周正，可举止轻浮，眼神油滑，生性好色。他目光第一时间便落在苏晚晴身上，视线肆无忌惮上下打量，言语轻佻，眼神直白无礼，全然不顾及在场众人。
苏晚晴面色冷淡，全程视而不见，无心理会对方轻浮举动，一心等待返程。
两名金丹长老带领门下所有随行弟子，护送苏晚晴、赵磊、许巧三人一同离开后山，一行人脚步声渐行渐远，最终彻底消失在山道尽头。
昔日一同值守的同门尽数离去，整片后山只剩下陈默、怀中蛰伏的雪白灵狐，以及孟峰带领的一众新任留守弟子。
孟峰转头扫了一眼陈默和他怀中乖巧小白狐，只当是一只普通灵宠，并未放在心上，随即扭头对着手下弟子分派巡逻任务，说话之时依旧时不时望向山道尽头，满心杂念。
陈默抱着怀中安静的灵狐，站在寂静木屋之前，望着空荡荡的山道。
往后一段时日，他与这只深藏不露的强悍灵狐，就要和心性轻浮好色的孟峰一行人，共同驻守这片刚经历过血战、暗藏未知凶险的后山密林。

Chapter 32: All the fellow disciples evacuate, leaving only two people to guard the mountain (page 1)
After the war, two Jindan elders stepped into the battlefield and used the pure Jindan spiritual power to suppress the evil spirits remaining in everyone's bodies one by one, temporarily stabilizing everyone's injuries.
Zhao Lei's forearm was fractured and his internal injuries were severe, making him unable to move; Xu Qiao's back was seriously injured and he lost too much blood and fell into a coma; Su Wanqing was injured in her shoulder. After days of fierce fighting and the death of a fellow sect member, the mental wear and tear was great. The three of them could no longer stay on duty in the remote back mountain and must immediately return to the sect's station to recuperate.
Not long after, all the disciples of Elder Jindan arrived and were carrying stretchers waiting for evacuation.
According to the elder's final arrangement, the entire back mountain guard team was evacuated, leaving no one behind.
Firstly, Chen Mo laid an ambush in advance for this battle, which greatly helped the battle. He had a calm mind and was suitable for staying behind, and he was not injured in this battle. After all, this is the important place of our sect and only hired guards are here, so there is a great danger; secondly, the Yinhun Sword restrained the corpse evil and was adapted to the mountain environment of the back mountain; thirdly, the spirit fox in his arms was powerful and could secretly deal with the unknown dangers that followed, so it was safest to leave him here.
So one of the elders pointed at a disciple next to him and said, "Fellow Daoist Gou and Daoist Su, this is my direct disciple Meng Feng, let him lead the team." Another elder looked at the young man being pointed at and saw that he looked upright and nodded and said, "Fellow Daoist Zhou, I think it's okay. This little brother has an extraordinary figure. He must be your direct disciple, and he must have a lot of magical powers, and his Taoist attainments are not low, right?"
It's very appropriate for him to be stationed here. After that, he looked at Su Wanqing and asked, "Fellow Daoist Su, what do you want to do?" Ha ha ha ha. "
Su Wanqing reluctantly said, "Okay, I have no objection.
The team left behind to take over the defense of Houshan was quickly assembled, and the leader of the team, Meng Feng, walked out slowly. Then he looked at Chen Mo and nodded to him. So he looked at the monks around him, nodded with satisfaction and exchanged greetings with everyone.
Meng Feng was born with a handsome appearance, his eyebrows were straight, but his behavior was frivolous, his eyes were oily, and he was lustful by nature. His eyes immediately fell on Su Wanqing. He looked up and down unscrupulously, his words were frivolous, his eyes were direct and rude, and he completely ignored everyone present.
Su Wanqing looked cold and turned a blind eye the whole time. She had no intention of noticing the other party's frivolous behavior and was waiting for the return journey.
The two Jindan elders led all the accompanying disciples and escorted Su Wanqing, Zhao Lei, and Xu Qiao away from the back mountain. The footsteps of the group gradually faded away, and finally disappeared completely at the end of the mountain road.
All the fellow disciples who were on duty in the past had left, and only Chen Mo, the snow-white spirit fox dormant in his arms, and a group of new left-behind disciples led by Meng Feng were left in the back mountain.
Meng Feng turned his head and glanced at Chen Mo and the cute little white fox in his arms. He just regarded it as an ordinary spiritual pet and didn't take it seriously. Then he turned to assign patrol tasks to his disciples. While talking, he still looked at the end of the mountain road from time to time, full of distracting thoughts.
Chen Mo held the quiet fox in his arms, stood in front of the quiet wooden house, and looked at the empty mountain road.
In the next period of time, he and this hidden powerful spirit fox will be stationed together with the frivolous and lustful Meng Feng and his party in this dense forest in the back mountain that has just experienced a bloody battle and lurks unknown dangers.
